changeHistory.revision: Aligned names with the system catalogue

processDefinition.name: Claims handling end to end (FNOL to Recovery)
processDefinition.purpose: Defines the stages, steps, decisions, service levels and RACI of the Corvane claims process, and maps each step to the CLARA programs and Claims Hub services that support it. Superseded versions are retained in the document library for audit purposes.

step.name: Receive notification
step.description: Notification received by telephone, portal, app, broker or telematics alert.
step.sla: captured during the call or on submission

claraPrograms.program: FNOL capture – main entry for telephone and portal hand-off
Overnight portal FNOL import (MyCorvane Claims, CLX-IF-001 backlog)
Nordic FNOL entry (Norwegian, Swedish and Danish fields)

step.name: Validate policy and cover
step.description: Check the policy snapshot from PALM and the cover dates.

claraPrograms.program: FNOL policy lookup against PALM snapshot and Vehicle Data Service

step.name: Create claim and default reserve
step.description: Create the claim number and the FNOL default reserve.

claraPrograms.program: Create claim record and default reserve (BR-FNOL-005)

rules.ruleRef: Default reserve at FNOL by claim type

step.name: Duplicate and late-notification checks
step.description: Check for duplicates (±3 days) and late notification (> 30 days).

claraPrograms.program: Duplicate claim check (same policy, date of loss ±3 days)
Late notification report (> 30 days after loss)

step.name: Acknowledge customer
step.description: Send the acknowledgement via Notify.
step.sla: 1 business day digital, 2 business days other channels (BR-FNOL-001 v3)

step.name: Sentinel pre-screen
step.description: Score the claim with Sentinel.

step.name: Tier classification
step.description: Classify the claim as Tier-1, Tier-2 or Tier-3.

claraPrograms.program: Tier classification batch – re-tier on estimate change (BR-TRI-003)

step.name: Route claim
step.description: Route by tier and fraud score.

branch.condition: tier == 'Tier-1' and sentinel_score < 30 and not bodily_injury

step.name: Major loss alert
step.description: Alert Major & Complex Loss for Tier-3 claims.

claraPrograms.program: Major loss alert for Tier-3 claims

step.name: Appoint Claims Assessor
step.description: Appoint an internal or panel Claims Assessor.

step.name: Inspect or desk-assess
step.description: Site inspection, video or desk assessment.
step.sla: 5 business days; Tier-3 within 48 hours (BR-ASM-005 v3)

rules.ruleRef: Desk assessment for low-value motor claims

step.name: Coverage decision
step.description: Decide cover based on the assessor report.
step.sla: within 3 business days of the assessor report

step.name: Estimate and recovery potential
step.description: Record the estimate and flag recovery potential.

step.name: Set initial reserve
step.description: Replace the default reserve with a claim-specific reserve.

step.name: Authority check and approval
step.description: Check reserve authority; escalate above limit.

step.name: Periodic reserve review
step.description: Review reserves; Tier-3 every 14 days from 2026-07-01.

claraPrograms.program: Tier-3 reserve review scheduler and revaluation (BR-RSV-007)
Monthly reserve indexation for bodily-injury claims (BR-RSV-009)

step.name: Large loss notification
step.description: Notify Reinsurance of movements above the LLNT.

claraPrograms.program: Large loss notification extract to ReCede (CLX-IF-031, BR-RSV-011)

step.name: Referral decision
step.description: Decide whether to refer the claim to SIU.

claraPrograms.program: Fraud referral creation – online (threshold read from CLR.T_PARAM)

step.name: Refer to SIU
step.description: Create the referral and the SIU case.

claraPrograms.program: Fraud referral creation – online (threshold read from CLR.T_PARAM)
SIU Case Manager export (CLX-IF-011 batch catch-up)

step.name: Notify customer of referral
step.description: Send the referral notice or record a deferral.
step.sla: within 10 business days of referral (BR-FRD-032 v2)

decision.question: Tipping-off risk certified?
decision.branch: defer up to 60 days where SIU certifies a tipping-off risk

step.name: SIU investigation and outcome
step.description: Triage and investigate; record NF, CF or WD.
step.sla: SIU triage within 3 business days (BR-FRD-035 v2)

step.name: Human review of adverse outcome
step.description: Documented human review before any decline (no auto-decline).
step.sla: within 5 business days of SIU outcome

rules.ruleRef: No adverse decision on fraud score alone

step.name: Settlement offer
step.description: Make the settlement offer.
step.sla: within 5 business days of the coverage decision

step.name: Payment authorisation
step.description: Authorise the payment within authority.

step.name: Sanctions screening and payment
step.description: Screen the payee and send the payment.

claraPrograms.program: Nordic payment file NOK/SEK/DKK to CPG (CLX-IF-021)

step.name: Close claim and zero reserve
step.description: Final settlement closes the claim and zeroes the reserve.
step.sla: within 1 business day of final payment

step.name: Fast-track straight-through settlement
step.description: Straight-through payment for eligible Tier-1 claims.

step.name: Identify recovery potential
step.description: Confirm third-party fault and recoverable outlay.
step.sla: within 10 business days of the flag

step.name: Open subrogation case and demand
step.description: Open the case and send the demand.

decision.question: Pursue?
decision.branch: not pursued; close or write off

claraPrograms.program: Subrogation demand letter extract to Notify (CLX-IF-026)

step.name: Solicitor referral
step.description: Instruct Quarryhill Solicitors.
step.sla: within 5 business days of the decision

step.name: Salvage disposal
step.description: Release total-loss vehicles to Salvanta.
step.sla: within 5 business days of total-loss decision

step.name: Recovery receipt and reserve adjustment
step.description: Post the receipt and adjust the reserve.

claraPrograms.program: Recovery receipt posting – nets recoveries from the case reserve

step.name: Write-off approval
step.description: Approve write-off of unrecoverable amounts.

decision.question: Write-off above £10,000?
decision.branch: approval by the Head of Recoveries & Subrogation

rule.title: External Claims Assessor appointment
rule.text: Tier-2 property claims above £10,000 require an external Claims Assessor (loss adjuster) from the panel, appointed within 2 business days of triage.

rule.title: Inspection SLA
rule.text: Site inspection within 5 business days of appointment (Tier-3: 48 hours).

rule.title: Desk assessment for low-value motor claims
rule.text: Motor claims with an estimate below £3,000 may be desk-assessed from photos received through the Evidence Intake Gateway (minimum 6 photos).

rule.title: Gradual-leak evidence threshold
rule.text: See the Claims Handling Manual for the wording of this rule.

rule.title: Subsidence structural engineer referral
rule.text: See the Claims Handling Manual for the wording of this rule.

rule.title: FNOL acknowledgement SLA
rule.text: Acknowledge digital FNOLs (portal, app, telematics) within 1 business day and all other channels (telephone, broker, post) within 2 business days.

rule.title: Mandatory FNOL data set
rule.text: An FNOL must capture policy number, date of loss, Claim Type (peril), loss location, contact details and a description of loss before a claim number is issued.

rule.title: Late notification review
rule.text: Claims notified more than 30 days after the date of loss are flagged for late-notification review at triage and the policy notification condition is checked.

rule.title: Duplicate claim check
rule.text: Before a claim is created, check for an existing claim on the same policy with a date of loss within ±3 days; a match must be confirmed or rejected by the Claims Handler.

rule.title: Default reserve at FNOL by claim type
rule.text: Create a default indemnity reserve at FNOL from the default-reserve table (2025 values).

rule.title: Linked-claims indicator
rule.text: Flag a linked-claims indicator when the claimant has 2 or more claims in 12 months, or when a bank account or telephone number is shared with another claimant.

rule.title: Fraud referral threshold (NISA Circular 2026/04)
rule.text: Refer a claim to SIU when the Sentinel score is 65 or more (all tiers).

rule.title: Customer notification of fraud referral
rule.text: Notify the customer in writing within 10 business days of a fraud referral that the claim is subject to additional checks, unless the notice is deferred under BR-FRD-036.

rule.title: No adverse decision on fraud score alone
rule.text: No claim may be declined, reduced or repudiated on the basis of an automated fraud score alone; every adverse outcome requires a documented human review by SIU.

rule.title: SIU triage of new referrals
rule.text: SIU must triage a new referral within 3 business days.

rule.title: Deferral of customer notice (tipping-off risk)
rule.text: See the Claims Handling Manual for the wording of this rule.

rule.title: Recovery potential identification
rule.text: Where a third party is wholly or partly at fault, the Claims Assessor or Claims Handler flags recovery potential and a subrogation case is opened within 10 business days.

rule.title: Subrogation pursuit threshold
rule.text: Pursue subrogation where the recoverable amount is £1,000 or more (NOK 13,000 / SEK 13,500 / DKK 8,600).

rule.title: Solicitor referral for recoveries
rule.text: Refer a recovery to Quarryhill Solicitors when the recoverable amount is £25,000 or more or liability is defended.

rule.title: Salvage disposal timing
rule.text: Total-loss vehicles are released to Salvanta Salvage within 5 business days of the total-loss decision.

rule.title: Limitation diary
rule.text: Set a limitation diary at 30 months for bodily-injury recoveries and at 66 months for property recoveries.

rule.title: Recovery write-off authority
rule.text: Write-offs of recoveries above £10,000 require approval by the Head of Recoveries & Subrogation.

rule.title: Initial reserve timing
rule.text: A claim-specific initial reserve must replace the FNOL default reserve within 2 business days of FNOL.

rule.title: Reserve authority limits
rule.text: Reserve authority: Claims Handler £25,000; Team Leader £100,000; Claims Manager £500,000; Claims Director £2,000,000; above that the Reserving Committee. Nordic reserves are tested at the GBP equivalent at the GL month-end rate.

rule.title: Tier-3 reserve review cadence
rule.text: Reserves on Tier-3 claims must be reviewed at least every 14 days.

rule.title: Reserve indexation for bodily-injury claims
rule.text: See the Claims Handling Manual for the wording of this rule.

rule.title: Large loss notification to Reinsurance
rule.text: Notify Reinsurance (ReCede) within 24 hours of any reserve movement exceeding the Large Loss Notification Threshold (LLNT) of £250,000.

rule.title: Reserve close-down at final settlement
rule.text: On final settlement the outstanding reserve is reduced to zero within 1 business day and a settlement close movement (type ST) is recorded.

rule.title: Payment authority limits
rule.text: Payment authority: Claims Handler £15,000; Team Leader £75,000; Claims Manager £350,000; Claims Director £1,500,000.

rule.title: Settlement offer validity
rule.text: A settlement offer remains valid for 30 days from the offer date.

rule.title: Sanctions screening before payment
rule.text: Every payee must pass WatchScreen sanctions screening before any claim payment is released.

rule.title: Straight-through payment for fast-track claims
rule.text: Fast-track claims meeting BR-TRI-006 are paid straight through without Claims Handler approval up to the BR-TRI-006 cap.

rule.title: Interest on late payment
rule.text: Where payment is made more than 30 days after settlement is agreed, add simple interest at 3.5% per annum from day 31.

rule.title: Claim tier classification (Tier-1 / Tier-2 / Tier-3)
rule.text: A claim is Tier-3 if any of: estimated incurred ≥ £50,000 (NOK 650,000 / SEK 680,000 / DKK 430,000); any bodily injury; solicitor or litigation involvement at notification; property total loss. Tier-2: £5,000–£49,999 or any third-party involvement. Tier-1: below £5,000, no injury, no third party.

rule.title: Routing by tier
rule.text: Tier-3 claims route to Major & Complex Loss within 4 hours; Tier-2 to specialist Claims Handlers; Tier-1 to the fast-track queue when BR-TRI-006 is met.

rule.title: Fast-track eligibility and cap
rule.text: Fast-track if Tier-1, Sentinel score below 30 and no injury; cap £2,000 (NOK 26,000 / SEK 27,000 / DKK 17,000).

rule.title: Sentinel pre-screen at triage
rule.text: Every new claim is scored by Sentinel (FRAUDNET before 2025-03-01) within 15 minutes of FNOL.
